summary: Validate each cart item, fetch its product, reserve requested quantities, accumulate reserved products, and return them; on any error, release previously reserved quantities and re-raise the exception.
inputs: self (ProductCatalog): Catalog instance used to fetch products and manage reservations.
items (List[CartItem]): List of cart items containing sku and qty to validate and reserve.
outputs: reserved (List[Product]): Products for which the requested quantities were successfully reserved.
main_effect: Return the list of reserved Product objects.
errors: Any Exception occurs during item validation, product retrieval via <SPL>commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.catalog.ProductCatalog.get</SPL>, or reservation via <SPL>commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.models.Product.reserve</SPL>.

Exception: Before re-raising, release any previously reserved quantities by iterating zip(reserved, items) and calling <SPL>commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.models.Product.release</SPL> with the original item.qty; then re-raise the original exception.
